punchline: He guessed the formula in 1967 and started testing it with money.
thirty_sec: In 1965-66 Thorp and Sheen Kassouf built warrant models, split convertible bonds into a bond plus latent warrants, and Thorp guessed the Black-Scholes formula in late 1967 and traded with it. In 1969 he co-founded Princeton Newport Partners.
question: Which input of your roughest calculation do you know least?
key_contrast: A rough model used early over a perfect formula awaited.
